name: Pregabalin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Start 150 mg/day in 3 doses; 300 mg/day within 1 week (maximum 300 mg/day)
Start 150 mg/day in 2 or 3 doses; 300 mg/day within 1 week; maximum 600 mg/day
Start 150 mg/day in 2 doses; 300 mg/day within 1 week; maximum 450 mg/day

usual_adult_dose.indication: Adjunct for partial-onset seizures (30 kg or more)
usual_adult_dose.dose: Start 150 mg/day in 2 or 3 doses; maximum 600 mg/day

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Opioids and other CNS depressants (e.g., oxycodone, lorazepam, alcohol)
key_interactions.effect: Additive cognitive and motor impairment; serious or fatal respiratory depression reported.
key_interactions.action: Start at the lowest dose and monitor for respiratory depression and sedation when combining.

common: Dizziness, somnolence, dry mouth, edema, blurred vision, weight gain, abnormal thinking (≥5% and twice placebo, adults)
serious: Respiratory depression (with CNS depressants or respiratory impairment)
Adverse reactions after abrupt or rapid discontinuation

contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to pregabalin or any component
monitoring: Sedation, dizziness and respiratory status (especially with opioids or kidney impairment)

pk.dialyzability: Yes: about 50% removed in a 4-hour hemodialysis (label).

sources.citation: Viatris Specialty LLC. (2025). Lyrica (pregabalin) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA021446, set ID d4734e7d-5079-455e-8ff5-8f4539c998a9, version effective April 15, 2025]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.

draft_notes: 'Start at the lowest dose' for CNS depressants paraphrases label 5.5 (truncated in our read); confirm.
